title: Law grad jumps to death from 13th floor in Bandra after women ‘threatened’ to frame him
content: Police registered a case of abetment of suicide against two women recently. A 24-year-old law graduate died after jumping from his apartment. The women had allegedly threatened to frame him in a police case. This caused the young man significant stress and anxiety. His mother approached Kherwadi Police after the tragic incident.

title: Woman’s skeletal remains found in B'luru home; lived alone after son, husband died
content: In a distressing incident, the skeletal remains of Dakshayini, a 57-year-old woman from Bengaluru, were discovered in her residence. Living independently and suffering from schizophrenia, she had lost touch with her family for nearly two years. The police notified her brother, who confirmed her identity. An unnatural death report is now underway, prompting further investigative actions.

title: Sarfaraz Khan in contention to replace Sai Sudharsan for Sri Lanka Tests
content: Sai Sudharsan is all but ruled out of India's Sri Lanka Tests due to a foot niggle, with Shaik Rasheed and Sarfaraz Khan emerging as the frontrunners to replace him. Rasheed's recent India A stint and strong feedback from the CoE could give the youngster the edge.

title: 'Changing colours like chameleon': Mayawati slams Akhilesh over PDA's 'Pandit' twist
content: BSP chief Mayawati criticized the Samajwadi Party's changing political stance. She accused the SP of altering its PDA formula for electoral gains. Mayawati stated the SP now targets Brahmin voters after noticing BSP's growing support. She urged all communities to remain vigilant against SP's casteist politics. Such deceptive strategies offer short-term benefits but not societal welfare.

title: Mark Zuckerberg gave an update on ‘Meta's 4 am layoff email’ to employees
content: Meta's CEO Mark Zuckerberg addressed the recent layoffs alongside substantial investments in artificial intelligence. Despite reporting impressive revenue growth, the surge in expenses, particularly from severance and legal fees, negatively influenced the second quarter's operating income. The company is committed to advancing its AI infrastructure to pave the way for future innovations and anticipates a reduced headcount due to the layoffs.

title: Estranged wife calls for Gardner's vice-captaincy to be stripped, slams CA
content: Ashleigh Gardner's leadership role faces scrutiny after her estranged wife's public accusations. Monica Wright questioned Cricket Australia's silence regarding the alleged affair with Georgia Voll. Wright believes a power imbalance necessitates consequences for Gardner's leadership position. The Sydney Sixers, however, remain supportive and intend to retain Gardner as captain. This situation highlights Cricket Australia's handling of private matters and workplace responsibilities.

title: Shubman Gill unlikely to bat in warm-up game, on track for Galle Test
content: Shubman Gill, the Indian captain, will miss the warm-up match following a finger injury he picked up during training just a day prior. To prioritise his readiness for the Test, the management has decided that he should take a break. While observing the match from the dugout, Gill also joined in a practice session in the nets.

title: Elon Musk's preferred state halts data center approvals, says 'prove' this
content: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has temporarily halted the approval of new data centers while regulators perform a thorough audit of existing projects. Developers are required to demonstrate their electricity and water usage, reflecting a response to mounting concerns surrounding the swift expansion of data centers. The primary focus remains on ensuring the safety and quality of life for all Texans.

title: Spain’s zebra mussels reach 40,000 per sq metre, damaging pipes and structures
content: Zebra mussels are proliferating swiftly in Spain's aquatic systems, resulting in considerable harm to infrastructure and creating disturbances in water supply. Experts advocate that modifying infrastructure represents the only effective long-term remedy. The mere removal of adult mussels fails to address the persistent issue of shell buildup. This invasive species has already led to substantial economic repercussions, which are projected to escalate.

title: Microsoft's top AI boss has a message for engineers using GitHub Copilot
content: Microsoft EVP Jay Parikh has told engineers that "tokenmaxxing is not what we are optimizing for," in an internal memo first reported by 404 Media. Microsoft has made OpenAI's cheaper GPT-5.6 the default internal model, set AI token budget targets for every division, and given employees dashboards to track individual GitHub Copilot spend. Many engineers, the guidelines note, burn hundreds to thousands of dollars monthly.

title: Rude wake-up call, listen to largest voting bloc in 2029: Tharoor on protests
content: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor stressed listening to young people and engaging them.  He noted Gen Z and Gen Alpha will be the largest voting bloc in 2029.  Recent protests and bypoll results showed the growing impact of young voters.  Tharoor believes the ruling party received a wake-up call from these developments.  The Congress party sees opportunities in upcoming state elections next March.

title: 7 dead, 11 injured after bus overturns on steep mountain road in Himachal's Chamba
content: Seven people died and eleven were injured in a bus accident near Chalunj Mor.  The incident occurred Saturday morning in Himachal Pradesh's Chamba district.  All injured individuals were taken to a hospital for necessary medical treatment.  Six of the injured were later referred to a larger hospital for further care.  Rescue teams were dispatched to the accident site for immediate assistance.

title: Two Ghaziabad hospitals that turned away child rape victim to give parents Rs 12L
content: Two Ghaziabad hospitals agreed to pay Rs 12 lakh to the parents of a deceased minor. The Supreme Court expressed concern over the insensitivity shown by the hospitals and police. The court will consider laying down must-treat guidelines for medical institutions. Police will also be mandated to video record statements of sexual assault complainants. This action follows the tragic death of a minor girl after being denied timely medical care.

title: 'Is India truly independent?' Cong targets Centre over US Bill on Russia sanctions
content: Congress leader Pawan Khera has raised concerns about India's autonomy when it comes to purchasing Russian oil. He criticized the government's unwillingness to confront Parliament over this pressing issue. Additionally, Khera expressed solidarity with students in Jharkhand protesting recruitment irregularities, emphasizing that it's a collective duty of all political parties to address student grievances. Meanwhile, Rahul Gandhi's forthcoming initiative aims to spotlight youth challenges and the aspirations of job seekers.

title: FIFA president Infantino denies alleged affair, calls UEFA claims 'defamatory'
content: Gianni Infantino has firmly rejected allegations that UEFA funds were involved in a former employee's exit package. The accusations highlight an abrupt promotion and a notable salary boost for the individual. UEFA maintains that the departure payment was compliant with the regulations at that time. This latest controversy intensifies the scrutiny on Infantino's leadership at FIFA, particularly following the controversial withdrawal of a World Cup investment proposal.

title: Dostoevsky, Tehran coup novels found in Atiq Ahmed's son's car
content: Tragically, Aaban Ahmed, the son of Atiq Ahmed, lost his life in a devastating road accident on Thursday. While his vehicle was found to contain personal belongings, including books by Fyodor Dostoevsky and Marjan Kamali, police clarified that these items were unrelated to the circumstances of the crash. The severe injuries Aaban suffered ultimately led to his untimely passing, while his associate Sonu remains in critical condition following the collision.

title: Friday’s downpour in Delhi wasn’t just about rain; it was about what happened after
content: Delhi has faced an unprecedented deluge at the start of August, marking the wettest beginning in sixteen years. As rain poured relentlessly, streets transformed into mini rivers, rendering underpasses impassable. Commutes were hampered, with essential services thrown into chaos. Though civic bodies assert improved drainage capabilities, recent floods highlight ongoing vulnerabilities, raising concerns about the metropolis's resilience to heavy rainfall.

title: Why Travis Head doesn't see himself as a 'true' Test opener despite runs in Ashes?
content: Travis Head shares insights on his role as a Test opener, acknowledging that he doesn't fit the conventional mold of an opening batter. His dynamic and aggressive approach aligns well with the demands of the top order. Australia is bracing for a challenging run of twenty Tests, with fixtures lined up in Bangladesh, South Africa, and India.

title: Women’s quota Bill: Rahul counters Rijiju, calls delimitation link ‘unnecessary’
content: Union minister Kiren Rijiju has called upon Rahul Gandhi to lend his 'unconditional' support to the Women's Reservation Bill. This appeal came after Gandhi's comments highlighting the necessity of women's freedom of expression for India's comprehensive development. While the opposition has shown its backing for the bill, they contest its connection to delimitation. The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023, is set to be implemented following parliamentary approval.

title: 'I may not fit in, but I'll fight': Sarfaraz Khan's cryptic post goes viral
content: Sarfaraz Khan's Test career faces uncertainty despite his strong first-class performance. He recently shared a cryptic message reflecting his current situation and determination.  The batter was again overlooked for the upcoming Sri Lanka Test series.  His fitness has transformed, and he returned to the IPL with good form.  Selectors appear to have other middle-order options ahead of him.

title: 100% tariffs on India? US Senate clears Russia sanctions bill; 10 things to know
content: The US Senate approved a bill allowing President Trump to impose tariffs on nations buying Russian energy. India could face up to 100% tariffs on its goods if the bill becomes law. This legislation pressures countries to choose between US markets and Russian energy purchases. India has increased its Russian oil imports for energy security and cost reduction. The bill now moves to the House of Representatives for further consideration.

title: 'IPL is part of our plan': Coach McDonald explains Australia's strategy
content: Australia's coach Andrew McDonald is committed to judiciously overseeing player availability during the IPL. With a jam-packed international calendar on the horizon, ensuring the well-being of fast bowlers is paramount. Collaboration with medical and coaching teams will empower players to make informed choices. Insights gleaned from 2023 will inform their strategy for juggling numerous commitments.

title: World U20: Ashish ends India's 10-year wait for javelin medal since Neeraj's gold
content: Ashish Yadav secured a silver medal in the men's javelin throw event. He achieved this significant feat at the World Athletics U20 Championships. Mohommed Ashfaq also broke the men's U20 national record in the 400m race. Amanat Kamboj finished sixth in the women's discus throw final. Basant progressed to the men's high jump final after clearing 2.14m.

title: Madhuri sells Juhu apt for Rs 4.40cr after 14 years; earns 127% return
content: Madhuri Dixit and her husband, Dr Shriram Madhav Nene, have sold another apartment in Mumbai's upscale Juhu locality for Rs 4.40 crore, nearly 14 years after purchasing it for Rs 1.94 crore. The deal reflects a capital appreciation of around 127 percent, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.

title: Bihar booze ban hasn't worked; lift it, fund development work: Report
content: A recent study advocates for the removal of prohibition in Bihar to foster state growth and enhance capital spending. It posits that banning alcohol hasn't curbed crime rates but instead has spurred illicit activities. By abolishing the prohibition, the state could potentially enjoy a tax revenue boost of 14 to 15 percent.

title: Bengaluru 3-star, 5-star hotels under scanner over expired food, poor hygiene
content: The Food Safety and Drug Administration Department's Food Safety Wing has launched action against several three-star and five-star hotels in Bengaluru after a special inspection drive uncovered multiple food safety violations.

title: Citizens Bank Park weather delay: When will Blue Jays vs Phillies start?
content: The Blue Jays vs Phillies game at Citizens Bank Park was delayed because of thunderstorms in Philadelphia. No official new start time had been announced as of the latest update. The weather also postponed Chase Utley’s Toyota Phillies Wall of Fame ceremony. The Phillies said they will announce new timings once conditions improve and it is safe to resume the evening’s schedule.

title: Travis Kelce hits major milestone with $200m investment amid fitness concerns
content: Travis Kelce recently shared an update about his investment in Six Flags as concerns growover his fitness ahead of the new season next month.

title: 'Officials will contact': CM Dhami responds to Rishabh Pant's appeal for land
content: Rishabh Pant reached out to the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, Pushkar Singh Dhami, seeking guidance for acquiring land. The Chief Minister pledged government support in line with existing regulations. Pant revealed his intention to construct his first home in his home state, expressing a preference for purchasing land at official rates. Officials will follow up with Pant to ease the land acquisition procedure.

title: Post Pahalgam, panel proposes security boost at major J&K sites
content: A parliamentary committee proposed an integrated security framework for Jammu and Kashmir's tourist spots.  This includes comprehensive CCTV coverage and centralized monitoring facilities for enhanced safety.  Clear inter-agency standard operating procedures are also recommended before peak tourist seasons.  These suggestions follow a terror attack and a committee visit to assess security arrangements.  The committee noted sustained growth in tourist arrivals due to improved security and infrastructure.

title: Govt proposes 25% quota for local students in Delhi private universities
content: Delhi government approved a bill to establish private universities in the capital.  The proposed legislation mandates twenty-five percent seat reservation for Delhi students.  Merit-cum-means scholarships will also provide financial relief to many local students.  A stringent regulatory framework will govern these new private institutions.  The government aims to enhance higher education access and quality for residents.

title: How Jadumani Singh's risky weight change nearly derailed his CWG dream
content: Jadumani Singh Mandengbam secured a silver medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.  He overcame significant selection hurdles and a weight category gamble to achieve this success.  His journey highlights resilience and determination in pursuing his boxing aspirations.  The young boxer's performance was part of India's historic boxing campaign at the Games.

title: India lags behind in race for fifth generation fighter jet; Turkey surges ahead
content: Turkey's KAAN fighter program is advancing rapidly with prototype testing and planned deliveries. India's AMCA program faces delays in engine selection and stealth material development. The KAAN's multi-prototype strategy accelerates its development timeline significantly. India's AMCA first flight is unlikely before the early 2030s. This progress gap could leave India behind in fifth-generation fighter capabilities.

title: Karnataka: Congress leader shot dead in broad daylight; attack caught on cam
content: A local Congress leader and contractor was shot dead by assailants in Udupi. David D'Souza, a former village panchayat president, succumbed to bullet injuries after the attack. He had previously served a jail term after being convicted in a suicide case. Police are investigating the murder, examining personal and business rivalries. The incident occurred on Friday afternoon in Padubidri.
